daily.today_energy: Your scales are balancing beautifully today. There's this magnetic pull toward authentic connections and deeper conversations. Trust the quiet moments—they're where the magic happens for you right now.
daily.love: Someone's been noticing your vibe, and honestly? You're radiating different energy lately. Whether you're single or coupled up, today's about appreciating the people who actually get you without needing explanations.
daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now. That project or task you've been sitting on? The universe is giving you permission to bring it to life. Lead with confidence, even if imposter syndrome tries to whisper otherwise.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance—maybe that's yoga, journaling, or just stepping outside for fifteen minutes. The nervous system vibes are telling you to slow down slightly and actually listen to what you need, not what you think you should do.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to trust your gut more than your overthinking brain. Venus is vibing with your sector of self-discovery, so lean into what feels authentic rather than what looks good on the surface.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, this is about knowing your worth. Someone might test your boundaries—stay grounded. If you're dating, quality over quantity energy is *chef's kiss* right now.
weekly.career: Mercury's got your back with communication vibes. That idea you've been sitting on? Now's the time to pitch it or at least talk it through. Your voice carries more weight than you realize this week.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for genuine rest, not just scrolling in bed. Movement that feels good—dancing, walks, whatever—will shift your whole mood. Hydration is lowkey your secret weapon.
